oneLine: Axiscades Technologies shares worth ₹741 crore traded in a block deal.

sources.title: Axiscades Tech shares gain 10% after equity worth ₹741 crore changes hands in block deal window

synopsis: Shares of Axiscades Technologies Ltd. gained as much as 10% following a large block deal transaction where a total of 40.61 lakh shares, representing 9.5% equity of the company, changed hands. The transaction took place at an average price of ₹1,824 per share, bringing the total transaction value to ₹741 crore. The official buyers and sellers of the transaction are not yet known. At the end of the June quarter, promoter Jupiter Capital Pvt. Ltd. held a 58.04% stake in the company, while public shareholding comprised 41.97%. Additionally, the article notes that last month Axiscades announced it is looking to acquire a 90% stake in Cloud Wave for around ₹254 crore with plans to subsequently acquire the remaining 10%.
